result.question: What happens to Uzziah when he seeks Yahweh?

readings.support: as long as he sought the LORD, God gave him success

assessments.reason: Verse 26:5 states, “as long as he sought the LORD, God gave him success,” which is equivalent in meaning to “God made him prosper.”

result.reason: The passage explicitly says God gave Uzziah success when he sought the LORD, matching “made him prosper.”
